build.beforeDevCommand: bun run build:sidecar && bun run dev:web
build.beforeBuildCommand: bun run build && bun run build:sidecar

security.csp: default-src 'self' customprotocol: asset:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost http://127.0.0.1:3487 http://*:* https://*:*; img-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost blob: data:; media-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'
